local elapsed=0;local reported=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() or reported then return end
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during open-door continuation')
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<5 then return end
 local from=self.position+util.vector3(0,0,66)
 local ray=nearby.castRay(from,from+util.vector3(400,0,0),{{collisionType=nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.Door+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.HeightMap}})
 print('RendingOpenCold ray object='..tostring(ray.hitObject)..' position='..tostring(ray.hitPos))
 assert(not ray.hit or not ray.hitObject or ray.hitObject.id~='0x1093ee0','Original animated door closes collision after save/load or animation completion')
 reported=true;print('RendingOpenCold passage clear')
end}}}}
